response.overview: Inspired by real-life testimonies, Les Évadés de Tindouf tells the story of five Moroccan detainees who escape after more than 25 years of captivity in the Tindouf camps. In the heart of the desert, three men and two women face hunger, fear and the dangers of an arduous journey, driven by one hope: to regain their freedom and return to their homeland. The story explores courage, resilience and the enduring human desire for freedom.
response.title: Les Évadés de Tindouf
